title: Cramer's Rule Solver
description: Solve 2×2 and 3×3 linear systems with Cramer's rule: see every determinant (D, Dx, Dy, Dz) computed step by step.
howto: Enter the coefficients and the right-hand-side constants.
Press Solve to see D, Dx, Dy (and Dz) with their full determinant expansions.
Read x = Dx/D, y = Dy/D (z = Dz/D). A zero D is flagged as no unique solution.

faqs.a: For a system A·x = b with det(A) ≠ 0, each unknown equals the determinant of A with its column replaced by b, divided by det(A): xᵢ = Dᵢ/D.
Then Cramer's rule does not apply: the system has no solution or infinitely many (the equations are dependent or inconsistent). The tool reports this instead of dividing by zero.
With the Rule of Sarrus / cofactor expansion, shown term by term so you can follow each of the six products.
